rootCauseHypothesis:
The production host appears to be serving a different route than the test expects: instead of ending on `/app`, it redirects/lands on `/ofertas` (and briefly `/login`). This usually indicates a hosting-side routing or redirect configuration mismatch—such as a stale deployment, incorrect Vercel redirects/rewrites, or app logic that derives the destination route incorrectly in production. Underlying error: Page URL expected to be 're.compile('/app')'
Actual value: https://volunti.vercel.app/ofertas 
Call log:
  - PageAssertions.to_have_url with timeout 15000ms
  -   - waiting for locator(":root")
  -     3 × locator resolved to <html lang="es">…</html>
  -       - unexpected value "https://volunti.vercel.app/login"
  -     16 × locator resolved to <html lang="es">…</html>
  -        - unexpected value "https://volunti.vercel.app/ofertas"

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Ensure the app’s post-login/post-navigation route resolves to `/app` instead of `/ofertas` on production hosting. Check any auth middleware, redirects, or server-side route rewrites on Vercel that may be sending users from `/login` or root to `/ofertas`. If `/app` is the expected canonical path, add/restore a redirect from `/ofertas` to `/app`, and verify that client-side routing and SSR agree on the same base path. Also confirm the deployment includes the correct latest build and that environment-specific redirect rules are not overriding the intended route.
